up: Retrieve canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity details (standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units) for all compounds tested in the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1054505'. Join activities with compound_structures to get the SMILES and with molecule_dictionary to get the molecule ChEMBL ID. Ensure the activity data corresponds to the specified assay_id.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = a.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = a.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054505'
